terminal_name: Tendrara LNG Terminal (gem.wiki page; no CSV row)
issue: gem.wiki coverage cross-check found a wiki-only page 'Tendrara LNG Terminal' (Sound Energy micro-LNG plant, Figuig Province) with no export-CSV row. Researched from independent sources and resolved as OUT OF SCOPE, not a missing terminal: it is an inland (~120 km from the coast, 33.06 -2.08) domestic-only micro-LNG/virtual-pipeline plant — ~100 million m3/yr of gas liquefied at the Tendrara field and trucked to domestic buyer Afriquia Gaz under a 10-year GSA; no marine LNG import or export. Verified: https://lngprime.com/lng-terminals/sound-energy-breaks-ground-on-small-lng-plant-in-morocco/46717/ (token 'Tendrara' PASS) and https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2026/03/283726/sound-energy-secures-2-2-million-as-tendrara-gas-project-nears-production/ (token 'Tendrara' PASS). Current status: commissioning, first gas targeted Q3 2026; Managem now holds 75% (ONHYM 25%), Sound Energy exiting. The wiki page's 'Export' type label is wrong under current methodology (Dar-es-Salaam class).
suggested_action: Do NOT add to the tracker (domestic-only, out of scope — scope gate resolved before staging). Flag to GEM staff that the gem.wiki page mislabels it an 'export terminal'; consider marking the wiki page out-of-scope/small-scale so future sweeps don't re-flag it.
